skill.description: Search TikTok content through SocialDataX, collect relevant samples, and compare content angles with traceable evidence.
skill.summary: Research TikTok topics using keyword search, content filters, bounded pagination, and evidence-based summaries.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: One command finding is confirmed because the documented npx invocation executes an unpinned npm package with access to the configured API credential. The remaining 30 findings concern Markdown formatting, provider links, expected authentication references, or readable multilingual text. No evidence found of embedded credentials, credential exfiltration, or prompt injection; the external package implementation was not included for review.

remediation.issue: The quick-start command executes socialdatax-skills@latest through npx with automatic installation approval.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version, verify package integrity, and require user approval before installation or execution with credentials.

content.user_title: Research TikTok Content With Traceable Samples
content.value_statement: TikTok content planning requires relevant samples and evidence that supports comparisons. This skill guides SocialDataX searches and organizes returned content into traceable observations.
actual_capabilities: Guide TikTok keyword searches through the SocialDataX CLI or the corresponding tiktok_search_posts MCP tool.
Filter searches by video, image, or all content types.
Limit collection by page count or item count and continue using returned pagination tokens.
Organize returned titles, authors, links, and content identifiers into evidence-based content observations.
Preserve partial results and resume within remaining collection limits when a continuation token is available.
limitations: Requires a SocialDataX API key and sufficient account balance; the direct CLI also requires Node.js, npm, and network access.
Search does not support exhaustive collection, and results cannot establish complete platform coverage or definitive trends.
The documented workflow is read-only and does not log in, publish posts, interact with content, or modify accounts.
The external CLI implementation is not bundled; its current latest version was not reviewed in this audit.

use_cases.title: Explore creative angles
use_cases.description: Find relevant TikTok samples for a topic and distinguish observed content patterns from proposed creative directions.

use_cases.title: Compare brand-related content
use_cases.description: Run bounded searches for competing brand names and compare returned samples while preserving source links and collection limits.

use_cases.title: Prepare an editorial evidence brief
use_cases.description: Collect topic-specific samples, organize recurring angles, and identify follow-up questions for the next planning meeting.

prompt_templates.title: Find initial samples
prompt_templates.prompt: Search TikTok for [topic] using one page. Summarize relevant samples with available titles, authors, and links. Separate evidence from interpretation.

prompt_templates.title: Filter a focused collection
prompt_templates.prompt: Search TikTok for [keyword] with video-only results and a maximum of 20 items. Group relevant samples by observed content angle.

prompt_templates.title: Compare two brands
prompt_templates.prompt: Search [brand A] and [brand B] separately, up to two pages each. Compare observed angles and disclose sample limits and unavailable fields.

prompt_templates.title: Resume an interrupted collection
prompt_templates.prompt: Resume [query] from the saved nonempty continuation token. Deduct collected counts from original limits, preserve partial results, and report remaining gaps.

output_examples.input: Show the expected report format for a one-page search about home workouts.
output: Illustrative format only; no live search results are represented.
Scope: home workouts; one page requested.
Samples: list returned titles, authors, and available links or content identifiers.
Observations: describe supported content angles separately from interpretation.
Coverage: report returned counts, missing fields, and any continuation token.

output_examples.input: Show how an interrupted search would be summarized.
output: Illustrative recovery format; no live request was performed.
Status: incomplete; retain collected samples and the reported error.
Continuation: resume only when a nonempty token is available and the original collection limits allow further requests.
If no continuation token exists, report the gap without automatically restarting from the first page.

best_practices: Start with one page and explicit item limits; expand only when additional samples answer a specific research question.
Keep source links or content identifiers and separate visible evidence from your interpretation.
Review and pin the external CLI before execution; keep API keys in environment configuration and out of shared outputs.
anti_patterns: Treating a small search sample as a complete account history or a definitive platform-wide trend.
Restarting interrupted searches from the first page without accounting for collected results, continuation tokens, or original limits.
Sharing API keys in reports or approving global installations and system changes without user authorization.

faq.question: What inputs does this skill support?
faq.answer: Start with a keyword or topic. Optional controls include content type, page count, item limit, and a returned continuation token.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY for SocialDataX. The direct CLI requires Node.js and npm; an equivalent MCP tool is also documented.

faq.question: Does it publish or modify TikTok content?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow searches content and does not log in, publish, like, comment, or change accounts.

faq.question: Can it retrieve every matching result?
faq.answer: No. Search has no stable complete-result boundary and does not support an exhaustive collection option.

faq.question: What happens when a request fails?
faq.answer: Preserve partial results and errors. Resume with a valid continuation token within remaining limits, and resolve balance errors before continuing.

faq.question: Is the external CLI included and security-reviewed?
faq.answer: No. The skill invokes an external npm package using latest. Pin and review a specific version before running it with credentials.
